description: Animated text highlight that sweeps left to right inside the glyphs.

props.description: Root HTML tag: span, p, or div.
props.name: as

props.description: Base text color. When omitted, inherits the parent text color.
props.name: color

props.description: Whether to show readable static text without shimmer animation.
props.name: disabled

props.description: Seconds for one complete pass; must be a finite positive number.
props.name: duration

props.description: Highlight color. When omitted, follows the current text color.
props.name: shimmerColor

props.description: Fade-distance multiplier from the highlight center; must be finite and positive.
props.name: spread

props.description: Plain text displayed when no default slot is provided.
props.name: text

slots.description: Plain text content; takes precedence over the text prop.
slots.name: default
